title: verify(depth=470) leaked RecursionError; verify() must catch and return False (DoS surface)
replay_message: V002 REPRODUCED: verify(depth=470) leaked RecursionError (RecursionError('maximum recursion depth exceeded in __instancecheck__')) — verify() must catch RecursionError and return False (DoS surface)
fix_hint: Broaden verify()'s except tuple to include (RecursionError, MemoryError); or wrap entire verify() body in try/except Exception: return False.
